name: asia-cement-followups
status: FROZEN 2026-11-12: source-verified development extension. Final blind held-out duplicate check passed (0 duplicate questions, 0 duplicate quotations); every mandatory quotation maps on the paragraph-v1 and section-v1 corpora. Any edit requires a new version.
purpose: Experiment 006: robustness of follow-up retrieval (joined, standalone and merged queries) across paragraph-v1 and section-v1 chunking.
compatibility: Loaded by Knowbase's Asia Cement parser as dataset 'asia-cement-followups'. Same four PDFs as asia-cement-realworld 1.0.0. Only `evidence` is mapped and scored; `corroborating_evidence` is reviewer-only.
source_of_truth: The same four SHA-256-pinned PDFs as asia-cement-realworld 1.0.0. Questions and answers were written from the PDF text only, without consulting chunk lists, chunk boundaries or retrieval results.

extends.relationship: separate development-only extension; the parent's 16 dev and 8 held-out questions are unchanged. AC-017 and AC-019 are verbatim copies, kept as known diagnostic cases and reported separately.

documents.filename: Business Partner Code of Conduct_for publication.pdf

follow_up_types.self_contained: Understandable and answerable without the previous turn.
follow_up_types.pronoun: Refers back to an entity in the previous question with a pronoun or demonstrative (it, they, them, that).
follow_up_types.context_dependent: Elliptical: the topic, document or actor is only clear from the previous question ("And if...?", "What about...?").
follow_up_types.topic_change: Moves to an unrelated topic; the previous question is noise for retrieval.

questions.previous_question: According to Asia Cement's Code of Business Conduct, what are the rules for employees accepting gifts or hospitality?

questions.reference_answer: No. Employees must never accept money or gift cards as gifts. Before accepting any other gift or invitation, they must evaluate its value and whether it could appear to influence them.

Evaluate value

evidence.quote: Never accept money or gift cards as a gift.
Before you accept a gift, invitation, or other benefit, first evaluate its value and whether it might appear as an attempt to influence you.

questions.previous_question: What does the Code of Business Conduct say about keeping accurate accounting records?
questions.question: What can Asia Cement do if a supplier refuses an audit or breaches the supplier code of conduct?
questions.reference_answer: The documents give two separate rules that should be kept apart. (1) The October 2025 Business Partner Code: if a Business Partner fails to implement corrective measures, the Company may suspend the relationship until remediation, or terminate without prior notice for substantive causes such as an unjustified refusal of an audit. (2) The May 2019 General Purchasing Terms: Asia Cement may terminate the purchasing agreement, if necessary after prior written notice, if the supplier breaches the 'Supplier Code of Conduct' those terms reference. The documents do not say that the 2019 Supplier Code of Conduct is the 2025 Business Partner Code, or which notice rule prevails.
required_facts: BPCC (Oct 2025): suspend until remediation, or terminate without prior notice, e.g. unjustified audit refusal
Purchasing Terms (May 2019): terminate, if necessary after prior written notice, for breach of the referenced Supplier Code of Conduct
Attributes each rule to its own document and date
Does not state or imply that the 2019 Supplier Code and the 2025 Business Partner Code are the same instrument or legally equivalent, or that one notice rule overrides the other

evidence.quote: If the Business Partner fails to implement corrective measures to comply with this Code of Conduct, the Company may suspend the business relationship until proper remediation is achieved or terminate the contract without prior notice in cases of substance causes, such as unjustified refusal of an audit.

We may terminate the purchasing agreement if necessary after giving prior written notice in the event the supplier is in breach of the principles and standards set forth in the Supplier Code of Con-duct.

questions.notes: 'Con-duct' is printed with a hyphen in the PDF (sic). Answer scoring rejects: calling the BPCC 'the supplier code referenced in the purchasing terms'; merging the two notice rules into one; claiming one supersedes the other. Saying the relationship between the two codes is not stated is correct. Both evidence quotations are mandatory.

scoring_guidance.retrieval: Use expected evidence passages (source key + PDF page + quote), not merely document-level presence. Map exact passages to indexed chunk ids when integrating with local database. The chunk indices are not stable across changes to the parser or chunker.
scoring_guidance.answer: Score correctness, required fact coverage, support for each claim, citations, and abstention independently. Accept semantic paraphrases; do not exact-string match answers.
scoring_guidance.abstention: For absent-detail questions accept either explicit uncertainty/no specified figure or the product abstention; reject invented numeric details.
scoring_guidance.heldout: Use dev cases for tuning, keep heldout untouched until final evaluation. Do not run exploratory experiments on heldout cases.
scoring_guidance.follow_up: Each follow-up includes previous_question. Run with the indicated conversational context; do not test it as an isolated direct question.
scoring_guidance.conflicts: Sources dated 2019, 2023, 2024 and 2025; do not silently assume the Supplier Code referenced in the 2019 purchasing terms is the same legal instrument as the October 2025 Business Partner Code.
scoring_guidance.corroborating_evidence: corroborating_evidence is mapped and reported, but never counted in HitRate, Recall, MRR or full-evidence-in-context, and an answer is never penalised for omitting it.
scoring_guidance.experiment_006_preregistered: Population for A-C: the 16 newly written answerable follow-ups (FU- ids) only. AC-017 and AC-019 are known diagnostic cases: reported separately, never counted toward A-C. Results are reported for all 18 answerable, the 16 new, and the 2 inherited. Primary: production hybrid retrieval at K=5, mandatory evidence only; metric = full evidence in context (every mandatory quotation in the 12,000-character context). Merged = M1 (list-level RRF, k=60, equal weights, 10 candidates per list, ties by chunk id), compared with joined on the same corpus. A: net gain, merged minus joined, >= +3 questions on section-v1 and >= 0 on paragraph-v1. B: regressions (joined had full evidence in context, merged does not) = 0 on the new pronoun/context-dependent questions and <= 1 across all 16 new questions, on each corpus. C: on the 9 new pronoun/context-dependent answerable questions, merged's aggregate full-evidence-in-context count is at least as high as both joined's and standalone's, on each corpus; MRR is reported separately. D: non-follow-up retrieval is verified identical by regression tests on asia-cement-realworld (this extension contains only follow-ups). Note: under the production follow-up heuristic (app/retrieval/followup.py) 7 of the 16 new answerable questions (1 of them pronoun/context-dependent) have identical joined and standalone queries, so merged equals joined for them by construction. Gates: every mandatory quotation maps on both corpora (more than 2 new questions excluded voids the run; exclusions apply to every condition); the offline replay reproduces the stored production and standalone top 5 exactly. Reported, not gated: HitRate, Recall, MRR, K=7/10, per type and document, OR configurations, characters in context, gains at exactly rank 5. A pass justifies only a live retrieval-only merged experiment and an independently written sealed held-out follow-up set, never a production change.
scoring_guidance.exclusions: Before freezing, 2 of the 20 newly written questions were removed: each had at least one mandatory quotation substantially identical (app/evaluation/blind_check.py: normalized equality or similarity >= 0.9) to evidence in the sealed held-out split of asia-cement-realworld 1.0.0. They were found by the blind check alone, not replaced, and their ids are not reused. No remaining question was edited. Final: 20 questions = 18 new (16 answerable, 2 unanswerable) + AC-017 and AC-019.
